data.name: Jayrajsinh
data.gender_notes: Jayrajsinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jayrajsinh is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Victory of Rama'. This name is a combination of 'Jaya' (victory) and 'Rama' (name of a God). It is a powerful and revered name in Hindu tradition. The name Jayrajsinh carries the meaning “Victory of Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayrajsinh usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Invokes the blessings of Lord Rama
data.etymology: Jayrajsinh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of Rama.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayrajsinh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
